name: Brimming Gauge
text: When you bid, gain +10 contract value for every 100 gold you have.
family: Additive contract value / Flat (scaled by gold held)
decision: At every shop, whether a purchase is worth dropping below the next 100 gold.
opponent: Visible when you bid; opponents can respond only by setting the contract.
aiNote: Skip a purchase that would drop you below a 100-gold step unless it is uncommon or better.
rationale: About +20 at 200–250 gold, slightly above the common budget because Gold Miner is on the thin list; holding more gold means skipping purchases, which limits it in place of a cap, and gold is counted before the round's income.
